edges.reason: owner is assigned directly from msg.sender in the constructor, giving the deployer unrestricted privileges
msg.sender is stored into players[nbUsers] and users as the betting player address
fallback increments nbUsers after registering the player
fallback adds msg.value to totalBets with unchecked arithmetic
fallback sets endBlock = block.number + 15 when the second player joins
fallback pushes a PlayerBets struct into users
fallback calls checkinter() before registering the player
fallback performs the unchecked totalBets += msg.value operation
checkinter ends the round by calling endLottery when endBlock has passed
checkinter reads endBlock to decide whether the timer expired
callback externally triggers the same end-of-round path via endLottery
callback is guarded by the isOwner modifier requiring msg.sender == owner
withrawFee is guarded by the isOwner modifier
destroykill is guarded by the isOwner modifier
endLottery selects a winner and invokes withrawWin which sends ether externally
endLottery reads totalBets as the modulo for the winning ticket
endLottery iterates over the users array reading amounts and addresses
endLottery computes winningNumber into a local variable
endLottery accumulates user amounts in sum without overflow checks
withrawWin sends 95% of the pool to the winner via transfer on an attacker-controlled address
the winner.transfer external call invokes the recipient fallback which can re-enter the vulnerable fallback/endLottery flow
withrawWin resets nbUsers to zero
withrawWin resets totalBets to zero
withrawWin resets endBlock to zero
withrawWin deletes the users array
withrawWin accrues 5% of the pool into fees with unchecked multiplication
withrawWin executes fees += tempTot * 5 / 100 without safe math
withrawWin stores the winning ticket into lastWinnerTicket
withrawWin records the winner address in lastWinner
withrawWin increments totalGames
only the owner can reach withrawFee which transfers fees to owner
fees balance is transferred out by the owner-only withdrawal
owner is the beneficiary and sole caller of the selfdestruct routine

normalization_plan.reason: index is a pure accessor parameter that only serves the getPlayerAddress core function and carries no independent semantics
index is a pure accessor parameter that only serves the getPlayerBet core function and carries no independent semantics
winner is the destination of the withrawWin payout and must be folded into that core function
winticket is only used to set lastWinnerTicket inside withrawWin and should be collapsed into it
sum is a transient loop accumulator owned entirely by endLottery and has no standalone meaning
winningNumber is a transient value derived and consumed only inside endLottery
i is a loop counter scoped to endLottery and should be absorbed by it
tempTot exists solely to size the external payout transfer and the fee computation, so it merges into that unsafe operation
